name: Vandal Berserkers

abilities.name: Frenzy
abilities.text: Improves a unit's attack capabilities for an extended period of time.

abilities.name: Rapid Advance
abilities.text: Improved unit movement speed over an extended period.

attributes.name: Berserk
attributes.text: This unit can go berserk during the battle. This makes them uncontrollable, they will automatically attack nearby enemies.

attributes.name: Resistant to Fatigue
attributes.text: Fatigue has less of an effect on this unit.

attributes.name: Hide (forest)
attributes.text: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

attributes.name: Scare (everyone)
attributes.text: This unit frightens all enemy units.

attributes.name: Immune to Fear
attributes.text: This unit is immune to the fear effects of scary units.

short: Battle-hardened madmen who will happily charge into the jaws of death.
history: Originally thought to be from Scandinavia, and settling in Poland during the 2nd century BC, the Vandals were a confederation of Germanic tribes who went on to successfully migrate down through Europe and into Africa, forming a kingdom there in AD439. They didn't stop there. Eventually, Vandal activity in the Mediterranean became so great that the Romans lost control of the sea and many of its islands, including Sicily. Following several Roman attempts to recapture their lost territories the Vandals invaded Italy, where they became the second of the Germanic barbarian peoples to sack Rome during the 5th century - bringing the city to its knees in AD455. This led directly to an attempted invasion of the Eastern Roman Empire, repelled by the Maniots - once the Spartans of legend - and resulting in the Vandals' expulsion from Greece. Eventually, the Romans gave up trying to destroy them, and the two co-existed uneasily until the Western Empire's collapse around AD476.
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
